deck_metadata.theme_overarching: meaning exists in deliberate absence, truth in what is not shown, the viewer completes what the card only suggests through radical minimalism
deck_metadata.details: A tarot deck rendered as 90% empty white space. Each card contains only the smallest, most essential detail - a single footprint, a falling brick, an empty chair. The vast whiteness is not blank but pregnant with potential meaning that the reader must project and complete.
deck_metadata.backofcard: Pure white with the faintest gray text in the corner: 'The card holds only what you bring to it'

card_spec.border: Imperceptibly thin gray line at the very edge
card_spec.style: Extreme minimalism, single small element in vast white space, Japanese aesthetic, ink wash subtlety
card_spec.technical_details: 3000x4200px, RGB, 300dpi, white background essential, single detailed element occupying <10% of card

wands.visuals: A single ember. A matchstick head. One small flame in the corner. Vast white represents potential energy unmanifested. Fire is the spark implied, not the blaze shown. The white space is the heat you feel but cannot see.

cups.visuals: A single water drop. The rim of one cup barely visible. A reflection of light on liquid. The white space is the ocean unseen, tears uncried, love unexpressed. Water is feeling suggested by its absence.

swords.visuals: The tip of one blade. A feather floating. A single cut line. White space represents thoughts unspoken, air moving invisibly. Swords are clarity in what is deliberately excluded, truth in negative space.

pentacles.visuals: A single coin edge. One seed. A pebble. The white space is wealth unmanifest, resources potential, earth before cultivation. Pentacles are material reality as possibility rather than presence.

major.name: The Fool
major.prompt: Vast white empty space. In the bottom right corner, a single small footprint about to step off the visible edge into whiteness. That is all. The footprint is detailed but tiny. 90% pure white. Mood: minimalist zen with profound emptiness, the journey exists in the space not shown.

major.name: The Magician
major.prompt: Pure white space. In the center, four tiny objects arranged in a small compass pattern - a matchstick, a thimble, a needle, a coin - each exquisitely detailed but collectively occupying less than 5% of the card. One small hand reaching from below. Vast emptiness. Minimalist perfection.

major.name: The High Priestess
major.prompt: Endless white. In the upper third, two small vertical lines suggesting pillars. Between them, barely visible, a crescent moon. Nothing else. The mystery is the white space itself. 95% empty. Subtle ink wash style. Profound absence.

major.name: The Empress
major.prompt: White vastness. Lower corner: a single pomegranate seed, cut open, detailed and beautiful. A tiny wheat stalk beside it. That is all. The abundance is implied by whiteness. Extreme minimalism with exquisite detail on the seed.

major.name: The Emperor
major.prompt: Pure white space. Upper center: a tiny throne drawn in the simplest line art, no one sitting in it. Small and empty. The authority is absence. 92% white. Japanese brush aesthetic. The emperor is whoever chooses to sit.

major.name: The Hierophant
major.prompt: Whiteness. Center: two small keys crossed, rendered in delicate detail but tiny. Above them, three barely visible horizontal lines suggesting steps. Nothing else. Tradition exists in empty space. Zen minimalism.

major.name: The Lovers
major.prompt: Vast white. In the middle: two small hands reaching toward each other from opposite sides of the card, not touching, separated by white space. That space IS the card. Exquisite hand details but tiny. 88% empty.

major.name: The Chariot
major.prompt: White expanse. Bottom corner: a single chariot wheel, small and detailed. That's all. The movement is in the whiteness. The journey is what you imagine. Radical minimalism. One perfect wheel in vast space.

major.name: Strength
major.prompt: Pure white. Lower corner: a small detailed hand gently holding a single lion's claw. Nothing else shown. The strength is gentleness. The lion exists in white space. 90% empty. Profound simplicity.

major.name: The Hermit
major.prompt: Whiteness. Upper corner: one small lantern glowing faintly, exquisitely rendered but tiny. One set of footprints leading up. That is everything. Solitude is the white space. Minimalist perfection.

major.name: Wheel of Fortune
major.prompt: Vast white. Exact center: a tiny mandala-like wheel, intricate but small. Four dots at cardinal points around it in the emptiness. The wheel turns through whiteness. 93% empty space. Fortune in absence.

major.name: Justice
major.prompt: White expanse. Center: tiny balance scales, perfectly level, each pan empty. Sword tip visible below. Small and precise. Justice is the equal whiteness in both pans. Zen aesthetic.

major.name: The Hanged Man
major.prompt: Pure white. One corner: a single rope knot. Small and detailed. The hanging figure exists in your imagination. The sacrifice is the emptiness. 94% white space. Profound minimalism.

major.name: Death
major.prompt: Whiteness. Lower corner: a single empty chair, small and precisely rendered. That is all. Death is the absence in the chair. Transformation is the white space. Japanese ink aesthetic. Quiet.

major.name: Temperance
major.prompt: White vastness. Center: one small vessel tilted, a single drop of water falling from it toward nothing. Exquisite detail on the drop. The other vessel exists in white space. Balance in absence.

major.name: The Devil
major.prompt: Pure white. Bottom center: a single small chain link, open. That is everything. The bondage is imagined. Freedom is choosing to see the whiteness. 91% empty. The devil is projection.

major.name: The Tower
major.prompt: Whiteness. Upper corner: one small brick, falling, detailed and tumbling. That is all. The tower exists in white space. Destruction is implied by one piece. Radical minimalism. Lightning not shown.

major.name: The Star

major.name: The Moon
major.prompt: White space. Upper center: one small crescent moon. Nothing else visible. The dogs, the path, the towers exist in whiteness. Mystery is absence. 94% empty. Profound suggestion.

major.name: The Sun
major.prompt: Pure white (the brightness itself). In one corner, tiny, a simple circle with small rays. One miniature sunflower. The sun is the white. Joy is the emptiness. Minimal but radiant.

major.name: Judgement

major.name: The World
major.prompt: Vast white. Exact center: a small wreath ring, empty inside showing more white. Four tiny marks at corners. The dancing figure completes themselves. The world is white space. 90% empty. Completion in absence.
